name: com.open.dqmvvm.login.LoginActivity
description: DQVM, DQ2020's Android MVVM library, uses this Activity for account and password sign-in; it can also open from a 2020: browser link. After the login flow reports success, it opens the library's saved-user screen.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes DQVM sign-in and prevents that flow from continuing to the saved-user screen.
